changes_this_cycle: Added software/audit_mundarica_pages.py, a deterministic structural page-accounting validator for Volume I.
The validator checks expected 1..N page blocks, ordering, missing blocks, duplicates and out-of-range blocks without certifying transcription accuracy or scan comparison.
Expanded tests/test_mundarica_completeness.py with a strict 324-page Volume I accounting test and explicit non-verification assertions.
Updated the MLHKP Streamlit smoke workflow to compile and execute the page-accounting validator before completeness and UI smoke tests.
Preserved all permanent Mundarica source IDs and kept every volume verified_complete=false.

streamlit_sync.detail: The existing Mundarica Streamlit interface reads Mundarika1.md dynamically and displays detected page-block count, first block and last block. This cycle added CI enforcement of the same structural page-accounting invariant; no cultural/transcription status was promoted.

blockers: Volume I repository bundle still lacks a registered authoritative scan artifact, so visual scan comparison cannot be certified.
Volumes II-XVI still have no corpus artifacts in the current repository build.
next_best_action: After CI confirms the 324-block invariant, persist the measured Volume I page-accounting result in the completeness audit and expose continuity/missing/duplicate metrics in the Streamlit Mundarica interface without changing verification status.
